topic: IRS VITA/TCE grants FY2027 selected applicants
category: Tax credits and free tax prep
why: IRS selected VITA grantees for Oct 1, 2026 to Sept 30, 2027; they need to reach EITC-eligible filers before the 2027 filing season (IRS: about 1 in 5 eligible don't claim EITC).

topic: Drug-Free Communities FY2026 new awards
why: ONDCP's September 2026 list of new DFC coalitions; 5-year grants up to $125,000/yr starting Sept 30, 2026, with 'provide information' (incl. PSAs) as the first strategy.

topic: Federal Medicaid work requirements start January 1, 2027
why: Expansion adults must meet work/community-engagement rules from Jan 1, 2027; Georgia's waiver expires Dec 31, 2026 and must then follow federal rules. Arizona: AHCCCS and partners launched KeepMyAHCCCS.com (Sept 9, 2026); nearly 417,000 members could be affected from Jan 1, 2027. KFF (Jul 24, 2026; updated Sept 2026): CMS interim final rule June 1, 2026 requires notices to all expansion adults about three months before the first lookback month (most states in September), in at least two modalities; broader outreach is not required.

topic: Michigan MDHHS community navigator network (Healthy Michigan Plan + SNAP)
why: About $12.25M grant (MCNP-2027) for a nonprofit-led statewide navigator network for residents affected by H.R. 1; applications were due Sept 30, 2026, awards not yet announced (no award announcement found in a Nov 25, 2026 search). Watch for grantees and secondary partners. Nov 26, 2026: still no award announcement found.

topic: Nebraska Medicaid expansion work requirements (phased May 2026 to June 2027)
why: Took effect May 1, 2026; first existing members affected at July 31, 2026 renewals, phased through June 2027. DHHS partnered with SHARE Omaha, United Way of the Midlands and county partners (June 30, 2026).

topic: Drug-Free Communities FY2026 recompete new awards (FY2025 recompete, July 2026 list)
why: ONDCP's July 2026 list of FY2026 DFC new awards from the FY2025 recompete names about 100 coalitions; CDC's related DFC notice (CE-26-0208) funds up to $125,000 per 12-month budget period for five years, with providing information (PSAs, social media) as a strategy.

topic: CMS ACA Navigator awardees, 2026-2027 budget period
why: CMS Navigator third budget period runs Aug 27, 2026 to Aug 26, 2027 (period of performance to Aug 26, 2029); no CMS Navigator funding in Oklahoma after its move to a state-based exchange on the federal platform (May 1, 2026). Nearly all awardees in Armin/Stefan states are already on the desks.

topic: Philadelphia Office of Worker Protections Community Outreach and Education Fund 2026-27 round
why: $100,000 for 4 to 6 community groups ($16,000-$25,000 each) to teach worker protections; applications closed Nov 6, 2026, awards expected December 2026, programs through June 2027. Watch for the grantee list. Prior cohort: Philadelphia Black Worker Project, NDWA PA Chapter, Restaurant Workers Coalition / El Comité, VietLead.

topic: Michigan MDHHS opioid-settlement youth substance use prevention grants (June 2026)
why: MDHHS awarded nearly $3.75 million to 12 community organizations (up to $375,000 each) to prevent substance use among school-age youth, funded with opioid settlement dollars; work includes prevention education and family-strengthening supports. Grant period not stated.

topic: ONDCP FY2026 CARA Local Drug Crisis grants (September 2026)
why: ONDCP's Sept. 22, 2026 release: about $3.8 million in CARA Local Drug Crisis grants to 50 coalitions for primary prevention focused on youth use of opioids, methamphetamine and prescription drug misuse (alongside about $66 million in DFC awards). Award list PDF not yet read; mine it on a later run. Nov 25, 2026: award list PDF still could not be fetched (fetch permission prompt went unanswered). Nov 26, 2026: award PDF and release still could not be fetched (permission prompt unanswered).

topic: Oklahoma Opioid Abatement Board grant round (applications Oct 1 to Nov 30, 2026)
why: Over $12 million awarded Aug 13, 2026 to 24 political subdivisions (cities/counties, not nonprofits); next round open Oct 1 to Nov 30, 2026, awards expected March/April 2027. Watch for nonprofit subgrantees or partners of the awarded cities/counties.

topic: Kentucky Opioid Abatement Advisory Commission 2026-27 prevention grants (fifth round)
why: AG Russell Coleman announced Apr. 23, 2026 nearly $34 million to more than 100 Kentucky organizations; the full list has a 'PREVENTION GRANT AWARDS 2026-27' block (58 awardees, 1- or 2-year awards) including coalitions and awareness groups. 8 added to Stefan's desk Nov 25, 2026; remaining prevention awardees are mostly youth clubs, schools, health departments and providers.

topic: Texas Opioid Abatement Fund Council long-term CORE grants (June 2026)
why: 80 grants totaling $48.9 million (June 25, 2026) for three-year projects, but the stated categories are treatment, care coordination and recovery support, not prevention or public information; award list page not readable today. Low fit; recheck only if a prevention round opens.

topic: Connecting Kids to Coverage 2025 Outreach and Enrollment cooperative agreements (CMS)
why: CMS's 2025 cohort: about $66 million, $850,000 to $3 million per award, five-year period of performance (notices of award Aug 4, 2025), for outreach and enrollment of children and families in Medicaid/CHIP. All 21 grantees in Armin/Stefan states were already in the Prospects table as of Nov 26, 2026 (Missouri Coalition for Primary Health Care = Missouri Primary Care Association).

topic: Georgia opioid settlement trust grants (Nov 2025 round, 109 projects)
why: More than $42 million to 109 projects statewide (Nov 17, 2025); only one recipient named in coverage: GUIDE, Inc. (more than $840,000, prevention-focused Youth Action Network), added to Armin's desk Nov 26, 2026. Full recipient list not found yet. Local trusts also funding: Augusta-Richmond County $510,013 to 6 programs (Oct 20, 2026; mostly Augusta University projects and a theatre, not in scope); Fulton County $644,002 to 5 organizations (Dec 17, 2025; mostly treatment/recovery) and a PREPARE prevention and education RFP (proposals due Aug 12, 2026; awards not yet announced).

topic: Tennessee Opioid Abatement Council Community Grants Cycle 3
why: $84 million approved for 3 years; portal closed; accepted proposals expected to be announced around Jan 15, 2027, contracts effective July 1, 2027. Watch for the award list.

topic: Pennsylvania DDAP Life Unites Us stigma-reduction community grants (Feb 2026)
why: More than $100,000 to four community organizations (up to $29,000 each) in 10 counties to reduce SUD stigma and educate youth, parents, veterans and educators (announced Feb 25, 2026). Grantees are small recovery/community groups (Hope Works, This Is My Quest, Ark of Safety, Drop-In Center Recovery Collective); skipped as weak fit, no leaders or sites confirmed.

topic: Delaware Opioid Settlement Commission grants (Oct 2026, $12.75M)
why: $12.75 million to more than 40 organizations approved Oct 19, 2026; named awards are recovery housing and treatment (atTAcK addiction, CORAS). Full list not published in coverage; low fit unless prevention awardees appear.

topic: OSHA Susan Harwood Training Grants FY2026 awardees (Oct. 1, 2026)
why: DOL announced about $10.2 million to 67 organizations (45 Targeted Topic, 22 Training and Educational Materials) for worker training and education on hazard awareness, prevention and controls; project period not stated on OSHA's list. Nonprofit worker-safety grantees in Armin/Stefan states added (PhilaPOSH, NCFH, SERI, Escucha Mi Voz); most other in-territory grantees are universities, colleges or trade groups.

topic: NCPG Agility Grants for problem gambling prevention (Spring 2026 awarded; Fall 2026 pending)
why: NCPG awarded $200,000 to five organizations on June 11, 2026 (awards $20,000-$40,000, 12-month period). Fall 2026 applications closed Aug. 19, 2026 for projects Jan. 1 to Dec. 31, 2027; NCPG says awards come about three months after the deadline, so watch for the Fall 2026 list.

topic: Ohio Medicaid Group VIII work and community engagement requirement (Jan. 1, 2027)
why: ODM partner packet (Aug. 2026): requirement takes effect Jan. 1, 2027 for expansion adults 19-64; six-month renewals beginning with March 2027 due dates. ODM offers a partner toolkit but names no funded community partners, so no leads from it yet.
